newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-STEELS WINS SECOND SUCCESSIVE STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-STEELS WINS SECOND SUCCESSIVE STAGE.

text.p: Belgian Tom Steels scored his second successive stage win in the Paris-Nice cycle race on Tuesday.
He won a mass sprint at the end of the third stage over 173 kms from Bourges. Italian Gian Matteo Fagnini and Frenchman Frederic Moncassin were second and third respectively.
Steels, winner of last season's Belgian classics Het Volk and Ghent-Wevelgem, won the final sprint in Monday's second stage from Vendome to Bourges.
Frenchman Laurent Jalabert, aiming for a third consecutive Paris-Nice victory, came in with the pack to retain his overall lead. Steels is second overall, three seconds behind.
Three riders, Frenchman Erwan Mentheour and Italians Mauro Santaromita and Luca Colombo, were thrown out of the race on Monday after failing new, pre-race blood tests.
The tests showed abnormally high numbers of red blood cells in the riders' bodies.
